data.title: Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana ETFs All Saw Outflows on the Last Day of the Quarter. What Happened?
data.description: Billions poured into Bitcoin funds throughout September, then something shifted on the very last trading day of the quarter. The answer reveals a hidden pattern that repeats every three months across crypto markets.
